preconditions.description: The length of the Berlandish word s must be between 1 and 100 characters.
The length of the Birlandish word t must be between 1 and 100 characters.
All characters in the Berlandish word s must be lowercase Latin letters.
All characters in the Birlandish word t must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if s == t[::-1] else stdout == 'NO'
